heading: A/R: a print icon only
alt: Production A/R Aging Summary toolbar with a print icon
caption: A/R prints a PDF in database order, not the screen's. No CSV.

heading: A/P: no export at all
alt: Production A/P Aging Summary with no export
caption: The A/P reports have no print, PDF or CSV.

heading: Export menu: PDF and CSV
alt: A/R Aging Summary Export menu open
caption: The native ⋯ Export menu on all six reports. Files hold exactly the rows on screen, in screen order, with the as-of date and locations, then Past due and the customer or vendor when chosen. S3-R1 to S3-R8, S3-R8a.

heading: A/P gets the same menu
alt: A/P Aging Summary with the Export menu button
caption: A/P Summary, Detail and Unpaid Invoices now export PDF and CSV. S3-R1.

heading: PDF over 2,000 rows is refused
alt: One message refusing a PDF over 2,000 rows
caption: "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again." Exactly one message. CSV limit 50,000 rows. S3-N1, S3-N2, S3-N3.

heading: A/R Summary: date only
alt: Production A/R Aging Summary with only a date control
caption: The Summaries and Detail reports have no customer, vendor or past due filter today.

heading: A/R Collection: date and customer only
alt: Production A/R Aging Collection with date and customer controls
caption: Collection and Unpaid Invoices have a customer or vendor picker, and their Totals row ignores it. No phone or credit term on the customer rows.

heading: Four chips on every report
alt: A/R Aging Summary filter row: As of, Customer All customers and Past due Any in grey, Location
caption: As of, Customer (Vendor on A/P), Past due, Location. "Customer: All customers" and "Past due: Any" rest grey, Past due with the design system’s hourglass icon. S5-R1, S5-R13, S5-R15.

heading: Past due menu
alt: Past due checkbox menu open with Any ticked, the helper line and 1-30, 31-60, 61-90 and 91+ days
caption: The native checkbox menu: "Any" ticked, "All ranges are included. Pick one or more to narrow.", then 1-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, 91+ days. S5-R15, S5-N3.

heading: Past due ticked
alt: A/R Aging Summary with Past due: 2 ranges (31-60 and 91+ days), narrowed rows and Totals
caption: 31-60 days and 91+ days ticked: the chip reads "Past due: 2 ranges" in blue. The Summary lists only customers with an amount in those ranges, at full balances; the Totals row adds up exactly these rows. S5-R15, S5-R16, S5-R17, S5-R18, S5-R19.

heading: The native Vendor menu
alt: A/P Aging Summary with the Vendor menu open: Search vendor, All vendors and the helper line
caption: Vendor chip with the truck icon, as on Inventory Value. Its menu: a search box, "All vendors" ticked, "All vendors are included. Pick one or more to narrow.", then the vendors. S5-R13, S5-R14.

heading: Two customers ticked
alt: A/R Aging Summary with Customer: 2 customers and the Customer menu open, 10 Trucking and 4 Star Truck Repair ticked
caption: Customer menu with 10 Trucking and 4 Star Truck Repair ticked ("2 selected", shown as tags in the search box): the chip reads "Customer: 2 customers", and rows and Totals narrow to them (4 Star Truck Repair has nothing open). S5-R13, S5-R14, S5-R19.

heading: Call list on A/R Collection
alt: A/R Aging Collection for one customer with Phone and Credit term on the group row
caption: Customer picked: the group row shows "Phone:" and, for users with View and Manage AP/AR Data, "Credit term:". The Totals row follows the customer filter. S9-R1, S9-R2, S5-R18. Exports carry the same lines and columns: S9-R3, S3-R5, S3-R8a.

heading: Vendor credits link
alt: A/P Unpaid Invoices with vendor credit C-1224 shown as a link
caption: A vendor credit’s number (C-1224) links to the vendor return it came from, under the bill rules; A/R credit memos and deposits stay plain text. S7-R9, S7-R10.

heading: A/R Collection, groups opened one by one
alt: Production A/R Aging Collection with two customers expanded
caption: Each customer opens with its own arrow; there is no way to open or close them all.

heading: Scrolling loses the customer name
alt: Production A/R Aging Collection scrolled, customer name out of view
caption: Scrolled into a long group, nothing on screen says whose rows these are.

heading: Expand all from the header
alt: A/R Aging Collection after Expand all
caption: One chevron in the top-left header cell: "Collapse all" while any group is open, "Expand all" when none is. Group toggles use the same chevron. S4-R1 to S4-R5, S4-R8.

heading: The customer row stays pinned
alt: A/R Aging Collection scrolled, customer row pinned under the headings
caption: While scrolling a group, its row stays under the column headings; the next group's row pushes it up and off. S4-R6.

heading: Same on A/P Unpaid Invoices
alt: A/P Unpaid Invoices scrolled, vendor row pinned
caption: Vendor rows pin the same way; re-sorting never collapses an open group. S4-R6, S2-R9.

heading: A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light
alt: Production A/P Aging Detail scrolled right in light mode
caption: No description anywhere; no column stays in place.

heading: Same, dark
alt: Production A/P Aging Detail scrolled right in dark mode
caption: Production in dark mode, for comparison.

heading: Info icon beside the title, light
alt: A/R Aging Collection title with the info icon closed
caption: The native report info icon sits right of the title; title, icon and ⋯ stay on one line, filter row below. S8-R1, S8-R2.

heading: Info icon open, light
alt: A/R Aging Collection with the description tooltip open
caption: Hover, keyboard focus or a tap shows the description; moving away or Escape closes it. The longest one: "Overdue invoices, unused credit memos and deposits for each customer to help you follow up on payments. Excludes invoices that aren’t due yet." S8-R1.

heading: Info icon beside the title, dark
alt: A/R Aging Collection title with the info icon closed in dark mode
caption: Same in dark mode. S8-R1.

heading: Info icon open, dark
alt: A/R Aging Collection description tooltip open in dark mode
caption: Tooltip in dark mode. Descriptions appear on screen only, not in the PDF or CSV. S8-R1, S8-N1.

heading: Open Balance pinned, light
alt: A/P Aging Detail scrolled right with Open Balance pinned
caption: The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is bold and pinned right; the group label stays at the left. S8-R3, S8-R4, S4-R7.

heading: Same, dark
alt: A/P Aging Detail scrolled right in dark mode with Open Balance pinned
caption: Pinned cells and links use the native colors in dark mode. S8-R3, S7-R7.

heading: A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1440: every column visible
alt: A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1440 pixels with every column visible and Open Balance pinned
caption: At 1440 pixels every column fits without sideways scrolling: Date, Location, Transaction Type, No., Vendor Name, Due Date, Past Due, Amount and the pinned, bold Open Balance. Group labels span to the total; text columns wrap. S8-R3.

heading: Every invoice number is a link
alt: Production A/R Aging Detail with links on invoices from another location
caption: Signed in to Heavy Duty, the Lethbridge invoices (S3-) are links too.

heading: Clicking one dead-ends
alt: Production Work Orders list with WorkOrder not found and status code 400 errors
caption: "WorkOrder not found." and "Request failed with status code 400", then the user lands on the Work Orders list.

heading: Links only where they can open
alt: A/R Aging Detail, links in the native report link style
caption: A number links only with the right permission and a location the user works at; otherwise plain text. Native link style. S7-R1, S7-R2, S7-R6, S7-R7, S7-N1, S7-N2.

heading: Another location asks first
alt: Switch location prompt shown on the report
caption: "Switch location? This work order is in Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Switch your active location to view it?" on the report. Switch Location opens it there. S7-R3, S7-R4.

heading: Cancel stays on the report
alt: A/R Aging Detail after Cancel, unchanged
caption: Same filters, open groups and scroll position. S7-R5, S7-E1.

heading: Every location, no way to narrow
alt: Production A/R Aging Detail with a Location Full Name column and no location filter
caption: The reports show the whole organization. The column is "Location Full Name" here and "Location Name" on A/P; the Summaries have none.

heading: Opens on All locations
alt: A/R Aging Detail with the Location chip reading All locations and a Location column
caption: Native filter row: As of, Customer, Past due, then Location, which opens on "Location: All locations". Untouched, the report matches today. Column labelled "Location", after Date. S5-R1, S5-R2, S5-R5, S6-R1 to S6-R3.

heading: The native Location menu
alt: Location menu open with Select all, 2 selected, both locations ticked and Clear selection
caption: "Select all" with "2 selected", every location in this report's own data named as in the top-right switcher, then "Clear selection". S5-R2, S5-R3, S5-R4, S5-R5, S5-R6.

heading: One location ticked
alt: A/R Aging Detail with only Staging Lethbridge ticked in the Location menu, Location column hidden
caption: One location ticked ("1 selected"): the chip names it, rows, totals and exports narrow to it, and the Location column hides. S5-R6, S5-R7, S5-R10, S6-N1.

heading: Cleared: No locations
alt: A/R Aging Detail with Location: No locations and the No record matches these filters empty state
caption: "Clear selection" leaves no location chosen: the chip reads "Location: No locations" and stays visible, and the table shows the native empty state "No record matches these filters" with "Clear all filters". S5-R6a, S5-R9.

heading: Summaries show "Multiple"
alt: A/R Aging Summary sorted by Location, Multiple at the top
caption: A customer with open documents at two locations reads "Multiple"; sorted by Location here. S6-R4, S6-R5, S5-R8.

heading: Drill-down keeps the as-of date
alt: A/R Aging Collection opened from A/R Aging Summary for 10 Trucking with As of 09/30/2026
caption: On A/R Summary with As of 09/30/2026, clicking 10 Trucking opens A/R Collection for that customer with the same as-of date (and the same Past due and locations when set). S5-R11.

heading: A/R Aging Summary as it opens today
alt: Production A/R Aging Summary, customers in no set order
caption: Customers come back in no set order, and no column header can be clicked to sort.

heading: A/P Aging Detail as it opens today
alt: Production A/P Aging Detail
caption: Inside a bucket, rows open most overdue first. No sortable headers.

heading: A/R Aging Summary opens A to Z
alt: A/R Aging Summary in customer name order
caption: Customer name order the way QuickBooks sorts ("10 Trucking" before "2 Trucking"), marked on the Customer header. S1-R1, S1-R2, S1-R4, S1-R7, S1-R8.

heading: Click the Total header
alt: A/R Aging Summary sorted by Total, largest first
caption: First click gives the useful order: money largest first. Second click reverses, third repeats the first. S2-R1, S2-R2, S2-R3, S2-R7.

heading: A/P Aging Detail opens by vendor name
alt: A/P Aging Detail, vendor name order inside fixed buckets
caption: Buckets stay in fixed order; rows inside each bucket go by vendor name (was most overdue first). S1-R5, S2-R4, S2-R5.
